data.name: White Sands Visitor Center
data.description: The visitor center was built in 1936 and is part of the historic district at White Sands. Inside you will find the park store as well as the museum for the park. Make sure you check out the wayside in the visitor center courtyard to learn about the unique construction style that makes the visitor center an incredible example of the "Spanish Revival" architectural design.
data.audioDescription: The Visitor Center is constructed of adobe in a common southwest style, with smooth walls, a rounded top edge and flat roof. Seen from the front, which faces the highway, the central part of the building is two stories, flanked on each side by a single-story wing. Along the front, between the two wings is a deep, covered verandah with benches placed along the wall. The entrance consisting of two, multi-glass-paned doors, is located at the left end of the verandah. Both the roof over the central section and the verandah in the front is supported by large logs which extend out several feet beneath the top of the wall. The walls are a pinkish-tan color with the wood trim being painted a dark brown. At the right end of the front of the building is a historic sign of white-painted adobe which reads, “White Sands National Monument Visitor Center. Information, Scenic Drive, Museum.” To the left of the visitor center is a similar adobe building which houses the restrooms, women to the far left and men to the right. A sidewalk between the two buildings leads to a separate parking lot at the rear, past a water fountain and two shaded picnic tables. The area around the building is landscaped with desert plants. The interior of the Visitor Center has red-tiled floors and white painted walls. Upon entering the building, you find yourself in a rectangular foyer. An opening on the right leads to a large room with informational displays, books and other educational items for sale and the information desk. On the wall at the left side of the foyer is a tactile map of the building. A star indicates your current location and there are also room labels are also in Braille. At the far end of the foyer, another set of double doors leads into an enclosed courtyard. A verandah with benches is located on two sides, straight ahead and to the right. The verandah straight ahead leads to the entrance of the Gift Shop, which may also be entered from the rear parking lot.
data.passportStampLocationDescription: The passport stamp is a black circle with the words "White Sands National Park" and "Alamogordo, NM" curving around the top and bottom of the circle, with the day's date straight across in the center.

data.directionsInfo: White Sands National Park is located off of US Highway 70 between the cities of Las Cruces and Alamogordo. The park is about 15 miles west of Alamogordo and 52 miles east of Las Cruces.

operatingHours.description: Visitor Center hours are 9:00 am - 5:00 pm year-round. It is open every day except Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.
